title: Cape Cod Creative Arts Center Faculty Exhibition
bodyHtml:
pwsbuilder January 18, 2021

The Cape Cod Creative Arts Center, 154 Crowell Road, Chatham is holding its 2021 Faculty Exhibition from Monday, January 11, 2021, 9:00 AM  through Thursday, January 28, 2021, 3:30 PM.

“A cross sampling of our talented faculty members, representing all mediums: Watercolor, Oils, Acrylics, Ceramics, Sterling Silver Jewelry & Pastels.

Teresa Cetto, Vera Champlin, William Davis, Ron Dean, Maryalice Eizenberg, Michael Giaquinto, Steve Kennedy, Jakki Kouffman, Robert Mesrop, Rosalie Nadeau, Paul Schulenburg, Ellen Scott, Odin Smith, Marian Strangfeld, Karen North Wells, Joyce Zavorskas, Andrea Petitto, Ann Hart, Robin Litwin, Kely Knowles, Liz Perry, Carol Odell, Ann Hanson, Paul Wisotzky, Amy Bourbon, Eileen Casey.”

View the virtual exhibit at https://www.capecodcreativearts.org/2021-faculty-show.

 

Posted in WHAT'S NEW
